title: Stackable Hanging Bin for Wire Racks \|Booth Setup
author: phishinmikeyd
description:
Maximize your display space and stay organized with this **stackable hanging bin system**, designed specifically for craft fairs, vendor events, and everyday storage.

This 3D printed bin features integrated hanging tabs that easily attach to most standard wire racking, allowing you to create a clean, vertical display without taking up valuable table space. The stackable design lets you expand your setup as needed, making it perfect for growing inventory or changing layouts.

Whether you’re showcasing products or organizing supplies, this bin delivers both functionality and a clean, professional look.

### 🔧 Features:

• Stackable design for vertical organization

• Built-in tabs for easy hanging on wire racks

• Compatible with most standard wire shelving

• Strong, durable 3D printed construction

• Lightweight and easy to transport

• Quick setup and reconfiguration

### 🛍 Perfect For:

• Craft fairs & vendor booths

• Farmers markets

• Small business displays

• Organizing parts or supplies

• Retail-style product presentation

Designed with makers and sellers in mind, this bin helps you create an efficient and eye-catching display that keeps your products accessible and organized.
